title: Task 1 · Recycling paper (process)
prompt: The list below shows the stages in the process of recycling waste paper. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features.
steps: Waste paper is collected from homes and offices.
It is sorted and the plastic and metal are removed.
The paper is mixed with water and chemicals and broken into pulp.
The pulp is screened and cleaned to remove ink and glue.
The clean pulp is pressed and dried into large sheets.
The sheets are cut and rolled, then sent to factories to make new paper products.
